title: Al-Afuww: The Divine Name for Erasing, and the One Verse Where It Meets Power
excerpt: Al-Afuww occurs five times. Four pair it with the name for covering a fault. The fifth pairs it with the name for power — and al-Muyassar says why: He pardons His servants while having every capacity over them.
seo_title: Al-Afuww: Meaning of the Divine Name in the Quran
seo_description: Al-Afuww appears 5 times in the Quran. The root means to erase a trace, not to cover it. What separates 'afw from maghfirah, and why 4:149 pairs pardon with power.
